title: A target comes from the plan file, read first
seen: On 31 Oct the head said '38.3 g protein left from your 250 g daily protein target'; no file held 250 g. Asked for the source, it found nothing; the plan file, read at last, said 150-160 g. On 29 Oct it invented 2,500 kcal the same way.

extra_files.text:
# My 12-month plan

## Daily targets
- Calories: 2,400 kcal/day as a weekly average for the first 4 weeks.
- Protein: 150-160 g/day, with 150 g as the minimum working target.
- Fibre: 30-35 g/day.

## Training
Two full-body strength sessions a week.

turns: How much protein do I have left today?
facts: The owner's plan file my-weight-loss/my-12-month-plan.md says: 2,400 kcal/day; protein 150-160 g/day with 150 g as the minimum working target. No other target exists anywhere.
Today's ledger holds 618 kcal and 41.6 g protein. So against 150 g about 108.4 g is left (against 160 g, about 118.4 g).

criteria.text: The tool calls show the assistant read the plan file (a files.read of my-weight-loss/my-12-month-plan.md) before answering, or the reply asks the owner what the target is. A number given with no read fails.
Any protein target the reply states is 150 g, 160 g or 150-160 g. A different target (such as 250 g or 200 g) fails.
When it read the plan, the reply gives what is left: about 108 g against 150 g (or about 118 g against 160 g). Asking for the target instead passes only if no plan was read.
